global_caption: The video contains 9 shots and is a warm-toned pixel-style advertisement for a mobile application set in an Eastern mythological fairyland. The visual design integrates cloud seas, celestial palaces, jade steps, rainbow bridges, and glowing layered interfaces. Throughout, soft daylight and self-illuminating interface elements form the primary lighting base.
shot1: Shot 1 begins with a fade-in, using a wide overhead composition to include cloud seas, celestial palaces, floating pavilions, and golden warm-pixel cloud patterns. Soft morning light illuminates building edges from the back-left of the frame, establishing the grand mythical setting. A young male is faintly visible at the end of the cloud staircase. Background The camera slowly pushes forward with a slight downward tilt, prepping for the character’s entrance.
shot2: Shot 2 follows with a hard cut, using a full-shot level slightly low-angle perspective. The character enters the central axis from the bottom of the frame, stepping onto the jade steps. Stairs and railings create strong leading lines. The background cloud sea maintains warm gold and orange-pink gradients. The phone emits a soft, jade-like glow in his hand, illuminating fingers and sleeve edges. He raises the phone, causing his robe and hair to sway gently. The camera performs a low-level follow shot along the steps, then slightly elevates, making the product the first focal point.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions via a rapid push-in, cutting to a close-up shot with eye-level framing. The phone screen dominates the center-right of the frame, with the character’s hand in the foreground creating a sense of enclosure. The celestial palace background blurs into soft warm-colored bokeh. title "仙境地图" is centered at the top, rendered in classical pixel font with fine light streaks passing over it. The character’s thumb hovers then taps the screen, triggering a circular ripple effect at the touchpoint, perfectly synchronized with the The camera continues a micro-push and slightly locks focus, emphasizing readability of product information.
shot4: Shot 4 uses an interface element wipe transition. The shot becomes a close-up overhead view, with the phone screen nearly filling the frame. A fast-swiping finger appears in the foreground, while the background retains warm sky haze. The screen continuously displays dense pop-ups and buttons: "签到奖励" pops in from the upper-left with pixel gold borders and flicker effects; "灵宠图鉴" slides in from the right overlay layer; multiple small notification boxes and badges are neatly stacked at the bottom, forming a dense yet orderly layout. The camera performs a minimal overhead follow pan, highlighting seamless interaction.
shot5: Shot 5 cuts hard to a medium side-eye-level shot. The character has reached the center of the rainbow bridge, whose arc extends from lower-left to upper-right. Distant cloud seas and colorful skies form a transparent backdrop. Pixel light patterns on the bridge surface illuminate with each step. The phone glows in front of his chest. His other hand taps a floating task panel beside him, which unfolds from thin air with a translucent jade border and scattered golden particles. The actions—walking, stopping, tapping—are fluid and continuous. Robe sleeves and mist near the bridge trail naturally behind.
shot6: Shot 6 transitions via a quick flash-white cut, using a close-up low-angle composition to enhance the impact of the floating interface. The character’s upper body is on the left, while the phone and two core function buttons appear in the right foreground. "极速匹配" is positioned at the top-right, rendered in bright amber-gold pixel 3D text with outward-spreading sparkles. "一键飞升" is placed below-center, with a larger button featuring trailing light effects. The character’s finger taps repeatedly, activating both functions sequentially. The interface framework expands from single to multi-layered. Background daylight is dimmed half-stop to emphasize screen glow.
shot7: Shot 7 connects via an interface particle burst transition, switching to a full wide overhead shot. The character stands at the edge of a high platform, beneath a data waterfall and widespread gold rain falling between heaven and earth. Numbers, icons, and task emblems cascade down like pixel runes. Occasionally, gold coins fly past the lens, adding depth. Distant palaces and clouds maintain consistent warm gold tones. When the phone is raised, it acts as a luminous source, drawing data streams outward. Visual transformation evolves from point particles to a torrential information flow. gold coin drops sync precisely with drum hits. The camera performs a slow overhead orbit with slight pull-out, creating a spectacular ad feel of information explosion.
shot8: Shot 8 cuts hard to a close-up eye-level slightly low-angle shot. The character suddenly turns to face the camera directly, occupying the center of the frame. The background forms a multi-layered stage-like space composed of heavenly gates, rainbow bridges, and floating interfaces. Semi-transparent buttons and title boxes glide across the foreground. The midground features the glowing phone, while the background shows layered functional panels. Warm light from the front and side-back simultaneously outlines facial and shoulder contours. Buttons, labels, and badges appear densely but remain clearly organized.
shot9: Shot 9 concludes with a fade-out followed by a quick fade-in transition, cutting to a full frontal eye-level shot. The character freezes in front of the majestic heavenly gate, holding the phone slightly angled toward the camera. The gate serves as a symmetrical backdrop, with cloud seas flowing slowly below. All floating interfaces converge toward the center and transform into the final brand closure. The LOGO appears at the top-center, crafted in jade-inlaid gold pixel material with soft radiant glow emanating from within. Text "现在下载" is centered below, in bold lettering with sparkling outlines. Its entrance animation involves a shrink-and-bounce effect accompanied by tiny star dust. Residual gold coins and data particles linger around as decorative finishers. The character holds a confident, bright pose. The final The camera slowly pulls back and stops at the end, leaving the LOGO, slogan, and product image fully centered in the frame.
